authorization: User explicitly requested comparing whether the association merely reflects slower walking.
statistics: Partial Spearman deviation vs POMA controlling speed: rank all three, regress ranked deviation and ranked POMA on intercept plus ranked speed, correlate residuals

bootstrap.resample: Independently resample healthy reference people and older stroke people; rebuild normal reference and deviations, then recompute ranks and partial correlation for each draw. Percentile 95% CI; count undefined draws.

prediction_comparison.method: Leave-one-person-out ordinary least squares; train 27, predict 1, for all 28. No tuning, clipping, polynomial selection, or outcome-dependent exclusions. Score reference is healthy people only.
metrics: number of people with lower/higher absolute error after adding deviation
prediction_comparison.scope: Descriptive small-sample predictive comparison, no model deployment or causality claim.

interpretation: A partial correlation with CI spanning zero means no clear extra association demonstrated under this adjustment, not proof that speed causes or completely explains the association. Rank residualization controls a linear relation on ranks; complex nonlinear and measurement-error effects remain possible. Original total association already inspected; this is a follow-up exploratory analysis.
